name: Spatial generative
summary: Deep atmospheric spatial composition: procedural generative particles, floating geometry with gentle parallax depth, and smooth continuous dissolves.

forbidden: bounce, elastic or back overshoot on any entrance (R1)
disorienting rapid camera rotations or uncontrolled particle acceleration
text occlusion caused by foreground floating particles

frame_checklist: Foreground particles move faster than background layers to convey true depth
Text elements remain on the sharpest focal plane with zero motion blur
Clean safezone clearance on bottom (>= 460px) and side bounds
Atmospheric fog or gradient creates clear separation between content and backdrop
source_techniques: WebGL & CSS 3D parallax spatial coordinate systems
licence_notes: Algorithmic CSS/Canvas particle generation; no external 3D models.
